plain: A formal statement, as a witness, that something is true.

webster.text: Testimony; witness; a solemn or official declaration, verbal or written, in support of a fact; evidence.

example.quote: INGERSOL did not consider the signing, either as a mere attestation of the fact, or as pledging the signers to support the Constitution at all events; but as a recommendation, of what, all things considered, was the most eligible.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, September 17, 1787
